claim_boundary: Fixture/schema validation proves the static RAS-015 Go tsnet connector, command/alias, migration, redaction, coexistence, and backup-exclusion shapes and named invariants only; it does not prove a connector binary, signatures, central command registration, native handlers, production wiring, Event Authority admission, IPC authentication, state persistence, tailnet enrollment, WAN behavior, public security effectiveness, E2E protection, backup/restore execution, native/web visuals, readiness, or certification. TSN-001..020 and TSX-001..005 remain runtime NOT_RUN.

semantic_rules.exact_return_context: request and result command_id, command_instance_id, correlation_id, and return_context must be byte-equivalent JSON values
semantic_rules.protected_auth_exact_return: hosted Tailscale protected authentication has one durable Server-owned operation; refresh and Client loss do not cancel it, while every protected open requires a current authorized Client/session handoff for that exact operation and generation and transfers no browser contents or cookies
semantic_rules.protected_auth_no_content_surface: protected authentication exposes no content and permits no caller navigation, capture, recording, or persistence
semantic_rules.funnel_consent_and_preflight: Funnel is hosted-Tailscale-only, off by default, and requires separately keyed explicit consent plus a current exact-generation preflight before enablement
semantic_rules.route_migration_identity_currentness: completed migration requires matched existing-Server endpoint/fingerprint evidence and current expected Server/endpoint/route generations
semantic_rules.connector_identity: exactly one active connector node is bound per stable server_id; external host Tailscale remains unmanaged and is deduplicated only after PM Server identity verification
semantic_rules.private_funnel_separation: private tsnet listener starts automatically after approved enrollment and remains independent of explicit hosted-only Funnel; Headscale remains private and Funnel disable preserves private access
semantic_rules.connector_backup_exclusion: Project copy/move/backup/source capture always exclude connector state; portable Full Server default excludes it; restore cannot create two live copies of one connector identity
